referee_caveats_inferred: All column densities are scaled from one template core (G9.62+0.19), so they inherit its Tk, source size and optical-depth assumptions; no excitation temperature is derived per source
Pair correlations between species may be partly built in because every N is proportional to a stacked intensity calibrated on the same template
Candidate selection is visual (>~5 sigma, round morphology) with no stated completeness or false-positive test for the 40 weak cores
Text says C2H5OH parameters come from C3 and CH3COCH3 from C2, while Table 1 labels C2H5OH as C1 and C2H5CN as C3
No uncertainty budget for stacking-derived column densities or for the standard-spectrum fit
Beam differences across frequencies in stacking and between SiO/H13CO+/CH3CHO maps are not discussed
Correlation coefficient type and the 'as extended as' criterion for CH3CHO are not defined
